reviews.text: A beautiful dog training center surrounded by greenery, very clean and well-equipped, highly qualified and helpful staff. My experience has been very positive both in terms of boarding and dog training. I definitely recommend it to anyone who needs it.
Thank you Valerio for the positive review, it's always nice to have confirmation of our commitment
Thank you very much Valentina
Thank you Giada for the esteem and trust that you and Loky have for us.
Thank you, Luca, for your mutual respect and friendship. We look forward to seeing you soon, along with Spritz and Kampari, whom we miss dearly.
Fantastic. Excellent experience both at the boarding house and at the daycare. Highly recommended.
Thanks for your review, Simone. Our boarding service is proud to have you and your four-legged friend among our guests. We'll do our best to always live up to your expectations.
I frequent this center to train my dachshunds where I found competence and professionalism
Thanks Luca for your review, our staff is always available

The place is fantastic. The staff is incredibly qualified. I met the Genovesi family many years ago when I took my first dog, a Doberman, to be trained, and from that moment on, my life with dogs changed completely. If you want to fully enjoy life with your furry companion, you have to come to them.
Thank you very much Nicoletta, we are happy to have met your expectations, see you soon

I'm starting some lessons that I have to interrupt due to an injury. They told me that if I don't finish the lessons within the allotted time (three months, of which I was not informed in advance), I'll lose everything. They told me about a notebook to keep track of the lessons, which I was never given. They told me that results had to be guaranteed, and I never complained about anything, especially since the training had just begun. But they kept the money (for now) both for the evaluation (which I had) and for the 10 prepaid lessons (three of which I had) without a receipt.

I took my dachshund Yuko to the Cineagonistica Lanciani training school, and we both came away happier and... much better behaved!
The team is knowledgeable, patient, and able to explain everything simply, without ever making either the dog or the owner feel out of place. Yuko, who is known for his "true dachshund" personality, responded immediately to the method: no rigidity, just professionalism and a great attention to his pace.

A welcoming atmosphere, well-explained exercises, and tangible results from the first lessons. Highly recommended for anyone who wants a calm and manageable dog, but also for anyone who wants to understand how to truly communicate with their four-legged friend.

Yuko approves... and so do I! 🐾
The staff is extremely friendly and knowledgeable, and the dog park is exceptional. Cleanliness and space for dogs are excellent.
Great experience!
🙏 thank you …

This is the second year I've brought my dog ​​to this kennel during the summer. The first year, I had a great time; when I went to pick him up, he turned away as if he wanted to stay on vacation :).
The second year, I noticed he couldn't wait to leave, and I found him so thin I almost counted his ribs. The woman told me he'd been running a lot and that's why he'd lost weight. When we got home, the dog seemed exhausted, barely able to walk, and a little depressed. He remained like that for a couple of weeks. The dog immediately developed a cough and conjunctivitis. We had been asked to get the mandatory cough vaccination. It took weeks for him to regain the lost weight and his good mood. Now I wonder, was it the separation from his owners or was he not treated as well as the first time? The management is kind and seems to care about their guests. The dog came out apparently clean but covered in fleas; I should point out that my dog ​​has never had fleas. I was asked to vaccinate him, get a chip, and undergo fecal analysis. Upon arrival, he was given a 20-day flea and tick treatment. The price was a bit steep: €20 per day + €20 for the flea and tick treatment for two weeks, which came to €320. Unfortunately, I promised myself I'd never leave him again... I don't dare give negative reviews, but one thing is certain: I'll never return to this shelter again.

She was indisposed and didn't give me a chance to explain the situation or ask about prices, excluding my dogs from the outset because they're 11 years old, and since it's not the first time they've been boarding, and for work reasons, I need to leave them.
She told me to contact the facility and demand it without letting me understand or speak!
I hung up right away.
Terrible treatment.

This was my second experience with the cineagonistica center. I left my two dogs (a Pitbull and a small mixed breed) there two years ago for a week and they had a wonderful time. This year, they stayed there for 14 days. When they were picked up, they were in perfect condition and spotlessly clean, thanks to the grooming service. I've had other experiences with dog boarding centers, but unfortunately, they weren't positive due to the "aggressive" nature of Pitbulls, who don't like at least 90% of the dogs around them. Many won't accept them outright, others aren't equipped to do so, having half-meter-high fences to keep poodles and dachshunds in. At this center, not only are they accepted without hesitation, but they are treated professionally. Despite the 14-day stay, the dog, who suffers greatly from loneliness, was taken back in perfect condition, calm, and not at all weightless. I recommend them 100%. Thank you, Ares and Birba

I wanted to leave a super positive review for this fantastic center.
I left my golden for a week, and the result? He had a great time, played a lot, and didn't mind the car and the heat coming on vacation with us.
I'm very happy because if I ever leave again, I can leave him knowing he'll be great. Thanks again, regards from York S. <3
Excellent professionals highly recommended
Competent Available PROFESSIONALS AT 500000000000000 STARS
17 days of boarding returned soiled with urine after their "supposed" grooming! And I won't add anything else.... not recommended!!
Experienced and professional staff. Highly recommended.
Very kind ok ok ok
Fantastic training center and really qualified staff

Exceptional staff. I've always left my dog ​​there and she always comes home feeling better!
Even in obedience classes, they're highly professional with our friends and so patient with humans!!!
Competent, professional and empathetic

My dog ​​Melody stayed there for 4 days and was treated like a queen. She even whined when she came home because she was having so much fun playing with the other dogs! She'll definitely be happy to go there on her next trip.

I'll start by saying that I can only offer my experience with grooming. I have a Maremma Sheepdog, so he's very hairy and sheds. Drying must be very thorough, especially with a vacuum cleaner, which removes both moisture and, more importantly, sucks up the undercoat, which is the most annoying part. The dog came home clean and smelling fresh, but not thoroughly dried and with a lot of shedding, most likely because they hadn't used the vacuum cleaner. The payment was a bit of a surprise, because they'd quoted one price on the phone, but when it actually came, they wanted a different one. I waited there for over two hours and never saw the kennel dogs come out of their closed kennels. I can't tell you how much they barked. I even asked, and they told me they were complaining because it was feeding time. I was there from 9:00 to 11:30. I, too, need a kennel. But I won't deny that I'm anxious about leaving him in a less than ideal situation.
I've been bringing my Labrador here since we got him, a second home for him. He's so happy every time we bring him here.

We've been entrusted to Giorgia, Marco, and the entire staff at Cinoagonistica Lanciani since Bruno was a month and a half old. Over the years, we've taken advantage of their boarding, daycare, training, agility, and driving. Bruno adores the entire staff, and Giorgia, Marco, Irene, and Giorgina adore our Bruno. Thanks guys!!!

I took my dog ​​on vacation twice this summer for about a week. When we picked him up, he was sad; he didn't greet me when he saw me again. He didn't eat for two or three days after we picked him up. Whenever I moved my arms or opened my hands near him, he always tended to close his eyes, as if he were afraid of being hit.
And on top of that, he came back both times with tracheitis. I strongly advise against going to the kennel. They never even showed me where he was being kept. Truly awful.
Experience 🔝 both in training our dog and every time we leave her at the boarding kennel. …
We leave our dog on holiday at the centre with great peace of mind, she is happy and comfortable there!
